create_Caffe2Boxes: create a Caffe2Boxes instance from a PyTorch tensor with 4, 5, or 6 coordinate columns
build_InstancesList: build an InstancesList to represent a batch of detection instances as tensors with image info and indices
use_Caffe2RPN_generate_proposals: use Caffe2RPN to generate region proposals from objectness logits and anchor deltas via Caffe2 ops
use_Caffe2ROIPooler_forward: use Caffe2ROIPooler to pool ROI features from feature maps using RoIAlign or RoIAlignRotated Caffe2 operators
run_Caffe2FastRCNNOutputsInference: run Caffe2FastRCNNOutputsInference to perform bounding box transformation and NMS on predicted boxes using Caffe2 ops
